reason: The question about the list of remotely accessible systems and their respective access methods selected answer B: remote access is permitted, but the list is missing, incomplete or not up to date. This is confirmed and resolved more specifically by the dated records: the maintained system register identifies the relevant systems but does not pair remotely accessible targets with their access methods (AR-13), and no other maintained register contains that paired information; the known jump-host and legacy RDP routes appear only in a one-off review note (AR-18). Although those routes and their target are identified (AR-07), this does not constitute an up-to-date maintained list. Because maintaining that list, including corresponding access methods, is the central obligation of PR.IR-01_P2 and the evidence explicitly establishes its absence (AR-18), the requirement is not satisfied.
